The Work

Therapy that moves in a sequence. We build footing before we go digging, and we make what surfaces usable before we move on.

Book a
Consult

Heather Daniel

Licensed Professional Counselor · CAS · CHT

I’ve spent my career where trauma and addiction overlap, drawing on EMDR, hypnotherapy, and an IFS-informed, somatic approach. Most of what my clients carry has never been only a thinking problem, so we don’t treat it like one.

I work with adults, one to one, in person in Fort Collins. If energy work, spiritual practice, or the felt sense of your own body is part of how you understand healing, you won’t have to translate that here.
